summary: Viskase Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Seventh Amendment to its Credit Agreement, entered by its subsidiary Viskase Companies with Bank of America. The amendment extends the maturity date by one year to August 2027 and increases interest rates on revolving and term loans by 100 bps. It also adjusts EBITDA definitions, allows disposition of the Osceola Facility and Chicago Property, and amends covenant thresholds. No acquisition, divestiture, or change of control is involved; this is a routine debt-refinancing event.
